Fixtures for tests/playbooks.test.mjs: two small kits with every field of docs/kits.md
(kits/), the playbooks written for them (topics/), and the code their errors come from,
each kit's in a folder of its own (sources/paintkit/ and sources/soundkit/), with comments
of every kind and a Markdown note there whose words are no message of a kit, so the
loader, the renderer and the checks of the playbooks are tried on files that are known to
be right, and on copies broken one rule at a time.
